title: Proper-support image on a geometric fibre
statement: In the setting of lem-cbc-proper-support-geometric-stalk, let c be a natural restriction map on geometric stalks satisfying the representative restriction formula. For a monomorphism i:G→f_*F whose sections are exactly the sections of F with proper support, the image of the induced map on the geometric stalk is a submodule S of the fibre sections, consisting exactly of the sections with proper support, and the stalk of G is isomorphic to S compatibly with the inclusion.

proof.text: Apply the geometric core theorem to the restriction map. It identifies the map as injective and its linear range with exactly the properly supported fibre sections. Set S to that range. The canonical linear equivalence from an injective map to its range gives an isomorphism from the geometric stalk of G to ModuleCat.of Λ S; its composite with the subtype is the original restriction map by extensionality.
